issues: The 'Whenever you play a Repair Mode' ability is encoded incorrectly. Replace the current onCardPlayed/grantOnCardPlayed structure with a direct triggered ability that triggers when you play a card named Repair Mode and grants Bane to a selected follower on your field.

The triggered ability to grant Bane is missing the actual target-selection form from the source. It should target a follower on your field (for example with targets.type 'selfFollower' or 'anyFollower' as appropriate to your controller-only field targeting), not wrap the effect as a granted future trigger.

The end phase condition is encoded incorrectly as fieldTraitMin with trait 'Amulet'. It should check whether there are at least 2 amulets on your field; add an implemented condition for counting field cards by cardType/amulet (or a dedicated amulet-field-count condition) and use that instead.

The On Evolve deck search is encoded incorrectly with searchDeckChoose/lookAt 40/remainderTo deckBottom. It should search the deck for an amulet that costs 3 or less, summon it, then shuffle; use tutorFromDeck with filter {cardType:'amulet', maxCost:3}, to:'field', plus shuffleDeck, or implement a dedicated search-and-summon-with-shuffle pattern.

The On Super-Evolve deck search is encoded incorrectly with searchDeckChoose/lookAt 40/remainderTo deckBottom. It should search the deck for an amulet that costs 5 or less, summon it, then shuffle; use tutorFromDeck with filter {cardType:'amulet', maxCost:5}, to:'field', plus shuffleDeck, or implement a dedicated search-and-summon-with-shuffle pattern.

The end phase condition is encoded incorrectly as fieldTraitMin with trait 'Amulet'. It should check whether there are at least 2 amulets on your field; add an implemented condition for counting field cards by cardType/amulet (or a dedicated amulet-field-count condition) and use that instead.

The second fanfare ability is encoded with the wrong effect. If this card was put onto the field by an ability, it should evolve itself; replace evolveOtherFollower excludeSelf:true with an effect that evolves this follower.
